title: feat(scenarios): the control cards gain Chinese asks, unanswerable twins and avg / max / min truths
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoBbtoXALZ2ejS37V1NN2Dga)_

epic:#33595#1 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibzrFc9Tmtf6LqQbGcX

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

Fixes #34296

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:三张对照卡(客户、发票、项目)给所有发给模型的文字补上中文(搭建短/详细提示、迭代变更、每个问数和操作的提问);每张卡各有 3 个答不了的问题,每个都配一个形状相同、数据里答得出的「孪生」问题;每张卡都至少有一个平均、最大、最小值的问数。答案全部由加载器从种子数据算出,不手写。
- 为什么改:云端客户用中文提问,`--lang zh` 此前会跳过这三张卡;每卡只有一个答不了的问题,分不出「该拒才拒」的模型和「什么都拒」的模型,孪生问题把两者分开;聚合种类多了,查询面测得更全。
- 风险与回滚:三张卡的问数变了(客户 8→14、发票 9→14、项目 8→13),改动后的评分表不能和改动前的直接比,eval#1 需要有意识地重定基线(它 M2 收尾的跑数钉在 31eb2aed,不受影响)。客户卡的种子多了一个数字字段 `employees`(员工人数),搭建提示里的数据契约会把它带给模型。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`docs/qa/scenarios/crm_account_with_contacts.json`(新增 `employees` 字段与 6 个问题)、`invoice_with_line_items.json` 与 `project_with_tasks.json` 的新问题段,以及 `packages/qa/scenarios/test/library.test.ts` 末尾新增的钉子。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 test/library.test.ts`,预期全部通过,其中 3 张对照卡各有「--lang zh 无缺字段」和「3 个答不了的问题 + avg/max/min」两条用例。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

Card JSON under `docs/qa/scenarios/`, and the tests that count it; no runner or scorer code (`packages/qa/scenarios/src/**` is untouched).

**Question counts, per card** (design point 5; eval#1 re-baselines on purpose):

| Card | Questions | Persona turns per Run half | Unanswerable |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| `crm_account_with_contacts` | 8 → 14 | 9 → 16 | 1 → 3 |
| `invoice_with_line_items` | 9 → 14 | 11 → 16 | 1 → 3 |
| `project_with_tasks` | 8 → 13 | 9 → 15 | 1 → 3 |

Operations (5 per card), personas, guardrails and agent actions are unchanged. Every existing question keeps its id, truth and English ask; the new questions are appended, so every existing question index is unchanged too.

- **Chinese text** (design point 1): `prompt.short`, `prompt.detailed`, `iterate.change` and every question's and operation's `ask` carry a `zh` beside the `en`, in business Chinese the way a customer would ask (`哪个客户的联系人最多?`, `把 INV-003 标记为已发送。`). Record names stay as the data spells them (`Acme`, `INV-002`, `Website relaunch`). The two inline-edit cards' `prompt.detailed.zh` say `内联编辑`, as the library's other inline-edit cards do. `promptLanguageGaps(card, { lang: 'zh', prompt }, ['scratch', 'template', 'ask'])` returns nothing for all three cards with either prompt length; pinned in `test/library.test.ts`.
- **Unanswerable twins** (design point 2): three `unanswerable` questions per card, each beside an answerable twin of the same shape over data the app holds:

  | Card | Unanswerable (reason) | Answerable twin (truth) |
  |:---|:---|:---|
  | crm | `acme_revenue` (existing): Acme's annual revenue | `acme_headcount`: Acme's employees, `sum employees` where name = Acme → 120 |
  | crm | `avg_credit_limit`: average credit limit | `avg_headcount`: `avg employees` → 60 |
  | crm | `most_open_tickets`: most open support tickets at one account | `largest_headcount`: `max employees` → 120 |
  | invoice | `tax_rate` (existing): tax rate on INV-002 | `inv_002_largest_line`: `max amount` on INV-002 → 100 |
  | invoice | `acme_discount`: discount across Acme's invoices | `acme_invoiced`: `sum total` of Acme's invoices → 220 |
  | invoice | `lowest_shipping`: lowest shipping charge of any invoice | `smallest_invoice`: `min total` → 75 |
  | project | `relaunch_sponsor` (existing): who sponsors the Website relaunch | `relaunch_open_tasks`: open tasks on the relaunch, `count` → 2 |
  | project | `office_move_hourly_rate`: average hourly rate on the Office move | `office_move_avg_estimate`: `avg estimate_hours` on the Office move → 7 |
  | project | `smallest_budget`: smallest project budget | `smallest_total_estimate`: `min total_estimate` → 4 |

  Each unanswerable is unanswerable from the card's `expect` and seed: no seeded object or field records revenue, a credit limit, support tickets, a tax rate, a discount, a shipping charge, a sponsor, a rate or cost, or a budget. None touches the object the card's iterate adds (opportunity, payment, milestone), so it stays unanswerable on the iterate Run half too. `relaunch_sponsor` asks for a person, which no truth kind expresses, so its twin is a figure about the same project.
- **Aggregates** (design point 3): every card now has an `avg`, a `max` and a `min` truth, each computed by the loader from the seed (crm: `avg_headcount`, `largest_headcount`, `smallest_headcount`; invoice: existing `avg_quantity`, `inv_002_largest_line`, `smallest_invoice`; project: `office_move_avg_estimate`, existing `largest_task`, `smallest_total_estimate`). The crm card had no number to aggregate, so its seed gains `account.employees` (Acme 120, Shopwell 15, Bitworks 45). The build prompt's data contract shows the seed verbatim, so the build is told the field like any other; `expect` is unchanged.
- **Personas** (design point 4): two new questions name personas, and their `personaTruths` come from the loader: `smallest_headcount` as `sdr` → 45 (Acme and Bitworks, the accounts u_sam owns; all rows → 15) and as `partner_user` → withheld (it hides `account`); `relaunch_open_tasks` as `contractor` → 1 (t3, u_kim's open relaunch task) and as `client_viewer` → withheld (it hides `task`). The other new questions name no persona.

## Tests

- `test/library.test.ts`: the hand-worked truths and persona truths of every new question, beside the existing ones (the evaluator is held to them). A new top-level `describe` pins, per control card: `--lang zh` leaves no gap in any mode with either prompt length, each Chinese text holds a CJK ideograph and differs from the English, three `unanswerable` truths, and an `avg`, a `max` and a `min` truth.
- The runner and export tests that run the crm card as their fixture re-count it: 14 questions, 16 persona turns a half, 21 turns with the 5 operations (`test/runner/orchestrate.test.ts`, `test/export/exporter.test.ts`). Each changed number is the old one plus the new questions; no grade semantics changed. With every account refused by the seed, the turns that stay measured gain the two new unanswerable questions and `smallest_headcount` as `partner_user`.
- The `--lang zh` refusal tests in `orchestrate.test.ts` needed a card that lacks Chinese, which the crm card no longer is: they now strip the `zh` texts from a copy (`englishOnly`), and the CLI skip test hands that copy in through `--cards` as an overlay card (`origin: held-out`).
- `test/refusals.test.ts`: the thin-seed case now raises `minFieldsPerObject` to 5 (the account carries 4 fields), the below-band case keeps the first 7 questions, and the gallery-floor fixture keeps the first 8.

## Acceptance notes

- The card's "Done when", in order: every runner-sent text has a `zh` (pinned); three unanswerable questions per card with twins, and avg / max / min truths (pinned); the loader computes every new truth, `validate` (the loader, zero refusals) and the existing card tests pass; the library ships as package data and the packed-tarball test confirms every open card is in it byte for byte. The counts that move are in the table above.
- Considered and dropped: a `min unit_price` question asked as `sales_rep` (withheld). Its withheld figure, 5, equals the mean quantity of sales_rep's own lines (15 / 3), which `scopeFigures` lists, so the leak reading could never flag it. `smallest_invoice` (`min total`, no persona) took its place.
- `relaunch_open_tasks` as `contractor`: the all-rows figure, 2, is also in contractor's own `scopeFigures`, so a reply stating 2 is graded wrong (truth 1) but not counted as a leak. `smallest_headcount` as `sdr` has no such overlap: 15 lies outside sdr's figures.
- `packages/qa/scenarios/README.md`: the `--lang` paragraph's skip example named `crm_account_with_contacts`, which no longer skips; it now names `some_card` and says the open library's three controls carry every text in both. A one-line wording fix outside the order's file list, named here.
- Rulings unaffected: no scoring code changed, so the cloud#3600 no-model-judge ruling and Ruling A on #31999 item 9 stand as they are. `packages/spec` is untouched; the card format is a test fixture format, not spec metadata.
- What an npm reader sees: `@objectstack/scenarios` ships `docs/qa/scenarios` as `dist/library`, so `npx @objectstack/scenarios run` runs the new controls. No export, exported type or CLI flag changes, hence `Clause-②: no`. Changeset `34296-control-cards-zh-twins.md`, patch.

## Verification

<details><summary>Truths and leak readings, computed by the loader</summary>

- Loaded the open library under `tsx` at `debc73e4`: 0 refusals. Every new truth equals the hand-worked value pinned in `test/library.test.ts` (crm `acme_headcount` 120, `avg_headcount` 60, `largest_headcount` 120, `smallest_headcount` 15; invoice `inv_002_largest_line` 100, `acme_invoiced` 220, `smallest_invoice` 75; project `relaunch_open_tasks` 2, `office_move_avg_estimate` 7, `smallest_total_estimate` 4; six `unanswerable`).
- `promptLanguageGaps` with `{ lang: 'zh' }` and `{ lang: 'en' }`, each with `short` and `detailed`, over scratch, template and ask: `[]` on all three cards.
- `scopeFigures` on the new persona questions: `smallest_headcount` sdr `[1, 2, 45, 82.5, 120, 165]` (the all-rows 15 is outside it); `relaunch_open_tasks` contractor `[1, 2, 2.67, 3, 8]`; the dropped `min unit_price` as sales_rep held 5 in its own figures (see Acceptance notes).
</details>

<details><summary>Local gates</summary>

- `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/scenarios^...' build` :: exit 0 (lock VERDICT command-exit 0).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios build && pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 && pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios typecheck` :: exit 0 (lock VERDICT command-exit 0) on `1b67d397` (`2f5d458f` after it adds only the changeset and one README line): 34 test files passed (34), 937 tests passed (937); `tsc --noEmit` clean. Before the edit, on `31eb2aed`, the same suite was 916 passed with only the two `test/build/*` files failing on their prerequisite (no `dist/`); after the edit and before the test updates, 30 tests failed, every one a count or a Chinese-gap pin on the crm card, each re-counted above.
- `eslint --no-inline-config` on the four touched test files :: exit 0.
- Derived gates (`dispatch-gates --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`, 9 paths, 62 families), each run with stdin from `/dev/null`: 61 exit 0, and `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exit 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: it needs every package's `dist/`; CI runs it). `check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` first exited 3 on the shallow clone (its pinned fixture commit unreachable); after fetching that commit into a private ref it exits 0.
- `--ran`: "62 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 61 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED (1 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3)".
- `origin/main` was merged once before opening (`debc73e4`); it touched no file under `packages/qa/scenarios` or `docs/qa/scenarios` and the derived gate set is unchanged, so nothing was rerun for it.
- 413 changed lines (+304 / -109) in 9 files before the merge. No governed surface, and `packages/spec` is untouched.
</details>

<details><summary>No ablation</summary>

- The diff changes card data and the tests that count it, no code, so there is no tested behaviour to ablate. The new `--lang zh` pin's failing direction is exercised by the refusal tests, which strip the Chinese from a copy of the same card and see every gap named.
</details>
